4. That the case of the petitioners is that the suit land originally belonged to Arjun Nath and Sree Raman Chandra Nath, they by two registered deeds sold the suit land to Karful Nessa, mother of the plaintiffs in 1350 and 1357 BS. That said Karful Nessa used to possess the suit land through her husband and sons, and after her death the plaintiffs possess the suit land. That recently when plaintiffs wanted to pay rents, then they learnt about the wrong record. That plaintiffs father was an illiterate person and had no idea of survey and the suit land has been recorded in the name of Railway. That said record is wrong and without basis. That plaintiffs learnt about wrong record on 5-3-1979 and for the aforesaid reasons they filed the suit. 

 14. Mr Fakir has drawn my attention to the supplementary affidavit that has been filed by the learned Advocate for the petitioners annexing the railway map and copy of the cadastral survey (CS) map wherein from their own papers it is apparent on record that the case land is outside the railway line and the same position has been found by the Advocate Commissioner in local investigation which has been very nicely discussed and taken into consideration by the learned Appellate Judge.
